considerations: Correlate matches with mail delivery and user click telemetry.
Use the action field to distinguish blocks from permitted requests.
Review URL paths and Entra sign-ins before inferring credential exposure.
Security scanners and automated previews can generate matches.
description: Review network or proxy events for the exact downstream domains Microsoft reported.

evidence.claim: Microsoft reported downstream destinations and a redirect path in deceptive Microsoft 365 service-health messages. The report did not confirm credential submission.
evidence.location: Lure and redirect flow, MITRE ATT&CK, and indicators sections

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Exact destination host matches can identify traffic associated with the documented phishing campaign.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Microsoft 365 Outage Phishing Destinations

1.json:
CustomWeb_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| extend HuntDestinationHost = tolower(trim_end(@"\.+", coalesce(iff(Host contains "://", tostring(parse_url(Host).Host), Host), tostring(parse_url(Url).Host))))
| where HuntDestinationHost in ("reallifeaccounting.com", "outagefixed.sbs", "outagerestored.sbs")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipal, ClientIp, RemoteIp, Url, Disposition, HuntDestinationHost
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
